title: Fix the three Android live-pass findings in the immersive recorders

completion_criteria.text: With self-view off, the video recorder's notice never says the camera is recording while the recorder is paused, and it keeps the spec 16.18 wording while recording.
completion_criteria.check: A widget test pumps VideoRecorderSheet paused with self-view off and asserts 'The camera is still recording.' is absent, and recording with self-view off asserts it is present; the paused test fails on main at ba529de.

completion_criteria.text: With the video let-go panel open, no full-window node is exposed to accessibility as a button labelled Leave; Leave is its own node (or disabled, matching voice).
completion_criteria.check: A semantics widget test on VideoRecorderSheet with asking true in the bottom-bar layout finds a separate Leave node and no window-sized node with the button flag, failing on main at ba529de; on the phone, uiautomator dump in that state shows no 1080x2195 clickable node labelled Leave.

completion_criteria.text: On a 411 dp wide phone in the bottom-bar layout, the idle video recorder's camera chip shows a readable camera name instead of 'Back cam…'.
completion_criteria.check: A widget test at 411x869 logical px with two cameras, one named 'Back camera 1', asserts the chip label is not truncated, failing on main at ba529de; a phone screenshot of the idle video recorder shows the full name or the chosen short form.
flutter analyze reports no issues and the full flutter test suite exits 0 on the fix branch.

spine.active_goal: Fix the three defects the 2026-09-28 Android live pass found in the full-window video recorder (shipped in #229 and #231): the self-view-off notice claims the camera is recording while paused, the Leave control merges into a full-screen TalkBack node while the let-go panel is open, and the camera chip truncates the camera name on phones. Each fix ships with a test that fails without it, then gets a live check on the phone.
spine.next_step: Ask the owner what the self-view-off notice should say while paused (spec 16.18 only defines the recording wording), then start with the TalkBack defect in lib/features/capture/immersive/recorder_surface.dart at `_leave()` (the `Semantics(button: true, label: recorderLeaveLabel)` around line 264), deciding with it whether video Leave should be disabled while the let-go panel is open as voice already does (video_recorder_sheet.dart line 288 versus voice_recorder_sheet.dart line 202).
